elements.text: Please rate this symptom from 0 to 6.

buttons: 2::2 – Mild: noticeable, but doesn’t affect my daily activities
3::3 – Mild to moderate: noticeable and somewhat bothersome
4::4 – Moderate: bothersome and affects some of my daily activities or training
5::5 – Severe: affects most of my daily activities or training
6::6 – Very severe: I can’t do my normal daily activities or training
